play.comments:
Played this solo between finishing the Pandemic Legacy Season 0 game (Early March) and making dinner. Went pretty well, finishing in a little under 90 minutes, with somewhere between 0 and 3 clues used - I looked at three clue cards (two on one puzzle, one on another), but none gave me strictly new info; just confirmed I had the cards I needed or prompted me to refocus my ideas and snapped my attention to the right spots.
Was surprised not to see any puzzles that used the box, or secrets in the common tools, in any way during this game - this seemed like one of the most 'typical' set of puzzles throughout. A few puzzles didn't quite click for me and felt like I'd missed something even as I solved them, although one in particular was because I thought I'd used more cards than I actually needed and I had to retrieve the set aside cards for a following puzzle!
Overall, fun to do and probably about right on the difficulty scale - several puzzles had me stumped for a good time, while a few were very obvious. Glad to have filled in the gap from the early set, but I think they've evolved well in general since the first selection and hoping to play some more recent ones soon!
